UnderstandingPrompt: Soldier elite training means that training, reorganization, incentives, discipline, welfare, military reform or other reasonable mechanisms grant native troop experience to ordinary soldiers in all current official lord parties and town/castle garrisons of target clans. The player's main party also counts as an official lord party when the player's clan is targeted. It may describe concentrated training results completed at policy activation or continuing training gains during policy validity; use both only when the body explicitly specifies both arrangements. Generic improvement of elite quality without a standing institution usually means concentrated training results. Explicit standing instructor corps, permanent training institutions or fixed training camps mean continuing gains. This does not increase hero skills or affect prisoners, militia, caravans, villagers, bandits, messengers or temporary parties. It does not directly replace or upgrade troops, recruit, or increase soldier numbers. Unrecruited notable volunteer slots and volunteer replenishment/growth belong to another effect; use soldier elite training alongside that effect only if the policy separately grants experience to ordinary soldiers already in active lord parties or garrisons.
EvaluationPrompt: Both values are experience per eligible ordinary soldier in lord parties and garrisons, not total Party or Clan XP, and are not diluted by target clan, party, fief or soldier counts. Native AI daily training baselines are approximately 10+tier*2 XP/soldier/day for ordinary lords and 15+tier*3 for clan leaders; adjacent-tier upgrade costs are approximately 100/300/550/900/1300/1700. One-time changes: 1–99 symbolic; 100–150 weak; 151–300 regular; 301–600 clearly elite; 601–1200 major reorganization; 1201–2500 very strong; 2501–5000 only for well-supported extreme policies. Daily changes: 1–5 mild; 6–15 moderate; 16–30 clearly institutionalized; 31–45 strong standing training; 46–60 extremely strong; 61–80 extraordinary wartime intensive training; 81–100 only for extreme policies. Daily 60 is already extremely strong: it accumulates 300 in 5 days and 600 in 10 days and stacks with native training. Judge values from wording, investment, organization and continuity. Never convert between the two timing semantics using policy days. When both are nonzero, they stack on the first execution day. Reaching XP thresholds only produces native upgradeable troop counts, not direct upgrades; healthy troop counts, wages, funds, items and special conditions still apply.
